verdict.rationale: Pandoc is documented as a standalone command-line program that you install locally (Homebrew, Chocolatey). It can also be compiled into a completely self-contained binary, so conversion clearly runs on the user's machine. However, the pack has no vendor statement that files are never uploaded, and the docs note pandoc will fetch content over HTTP when given a URI. Missing for 10: an explicit vendor statement that files are never uploaded, documentation of fully offline operation or no network transmission, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, conversion runs entirely on my machine, and the vendor states that files are never uploaded

citations.quote: Pandoc includes a Haskell library and a standalone command-line program.
The resulting binary can be run from any directory and is completely self-contained.
Alternatively, you can install pandoc using Homebrew: brew install pandoc
